cases.label: bcc_fe
cases.description: Bulk iron in the BCC structure, 1-atom primitive cell. This is a ferromagnetic system: use spin-polarized DFT (ISPIN = 2) with an initial MAGMOM of about 5 muB on iron. Compute the ground-state SCF energy with PBE.
cases.notes: Tests the agent's awareness of ISPIN=2 + MAGMOM for magnetic systems.
